title: Fire Flower
paragraphs: “Oh my.”

The older sister of the big sister let out a surprised voice at Father’s speech. A natural reaction. Father’s territory… I heard that Éclair’s parents’ land was where the first wave occurred. And it was also the village where the big sister lived. Since she’s the big sister’s older sister, she must have lived there before the waves.
“That sounds like an interesting thing you’re doing.”
“Is it interesting? Anyway… we’ve ended up with quite a big group, haven’t we?”
“So we’re sending the moles back to their village?”
“For now, yeah. Even if we’re going to help them, it’s better to start by rebuilding their livelihood… Of course, we won’t hesitate to offer our support.”
Father looked around at the moles.
“There aren’t as many of them as the filolials, but it’s hard to keep them in the castle forever.”
“Filolials can procure their own food, after all.”
Filolials run through the wilds to gather food for themselves. In that respect, the village slaves only eat the fruits of the plants Father cultivated or the meat they hunt under his instructions.
Oh… filolials truly are the supreme beings.
“If you’re worried, we can assign filolials to guard the village…”
At that point, Father stopped speaking and looked at Yuki-chan and Sakura-chan. Then, with a thoughtful expression, he began to ponder.
What’s with that look?
“Are you thinking about something?”
“Hmm…”
“Father is worried that Imia-chan’s relatives might get eaten by wild filolials!”
My rival blurted that out as if he had been waiting for this moment.
What did you say? I wouldn’t mind shoving this spear right into that mouth of yours.
“Probably. Imia’s been almost eaten more than once…”
Ren chimed in, providing covering fire.
What?
I won’t tolerate anyone badmouthing filolials!
“Y-Yuki-chan, can you pick out the calmer filolials, the ones that recognize Imia-chan as a companion?”
“Understood.”
Yuki-chan is the filolial representative, after all. This kind of request is best left to Yuki-chan.
“For now, Naofumi, I’ll deliver the Luumo folks to Melromarc later. I’m worried about Itsuki too, so I’ll check in on him while I’m at it.”
“Wouldn’t it be better if I went as the representative…?”
When Father rejected Ren’s proposal, Ren raised one hand and gave a light wave.

“I don’t mind helping out, but we need to secure trustworthy allies in preparation for the waves. Of course, I’m not saying I doubt Imia’s relatives. But Naofumi, only someone with your negotiation skills can recruit that panda. So it makes more sense for me to go since I can move around freely.”
Oh, Ren is trying to take over Father’s tasks with a very serious expression. Ren is occasionally useful.
“Indeed. The demi-humans of Melromarc also fall under my jurisdiction. I should be able to stand in for Iwatani-dono in this matter.”
Éclair is showing her enthusiasm. In other words, Éclair will assist Ren as well. With that, there shouldn’t be any issues in terms of manpower.
“We’re going to celebrate the reunion and have a meal at the tavern afterward, but first, we need to secure a place to sleep, right?”
“Well… where we’re staying can’t accommodate that many people.”
“Iwatani-dono, I will ask the queen to arrange lodging at the castle in Melromarc with Amaki-dono. Please enjoy celebrating Imia-dono’s reunion in the meantime.”
“Got it. But… is it really okay to have such a formal party here?”
“Um… everyone’s hungry, so just having a meal will be more than enough.”
The mole made this suggestion to Father. The other moles reacted in the same way.
“Okay, then I’ll see if there’s a place nearby that can accommodate a large group.”
Father seems quite capable when it comes to these things.
“Let’s go then, Amaki-dono.”
“Yeah, see you later.”
“Sorry about this, you two.”
“It’s not like I can drink anyway. Naofumi’s cooking is the best. Make me something later to make up for it.”
“This is my duty, Iwatani-dono.”
With that, Ren and Éclair teleported away using the portal. And so, Father, Yuki-chan, the moles, and I remained.
“What should I do now?”

“Just enjoy yourself along with everyone else. Motoyasu-kun, try to empathize with Imia-chan and the others. For example… imagine if you finally reunited with Filo after she had been forced into harsh labor as a slave…”
Oh… that situation vividly plays out in my mind. I would rescue a battered and suffering Filo-tan from a cage.
In that situation, what I need to do is treat her wounds, provide her with food… and secure a place for her to sleep! In such a moment, my duty is clear… I must restore Filo-tan’s smile!
“Understood! I, Motoyasu, will go above and beyond for everyone here!”
Father had a somewhat troubled expression. Why that face? This is the part where you should be laughing.
That’s right. Perhaps I should put on some kind of amusing performance?
“Whoa! I went overboard! Motoyasu-kun, just try to keep it a bit more mellow so that everyone can enjoy themselves! Whether it’s chatting or some party trick, anything is fine.”
“Hahaha! I’ll liven things up to the fullest! Yes, indeed! Let’s celebrate the reunion with fireworks!”
I focus my mind and begin chanting the spell.
“Mo-Motoyasu-kun! Someone, stop Motoyasu-kun!”
“It’s fine, Father! I’m casting this spell with the joy of reuniting with Filo-tan in my heart!”
There’s no way I would let Filo-tan get hurt, and I’m following Father’s previous warning to avoid causing any damage.
“All Liberation Fire Flower!”

I launched my original magic high into the sky. Its base is Prominence. I combined it with Burst Fire, an exploding spell. It’s a display spell. With a whooshing sound, the magic I cast soared high into the sky over Zeltoble and bloomed into a magnificent firework.
“Wow… it’s really beautiful, but isn’t it bad to do that without permission?”
“It’s fine. This should be just right.”
The assistant was unfolding some kind of paper.
“Umm, during nighttime in Zeltoble, launching fireworks is permitted? So, there’s a no-fly time for the airspace? Phew… we’re safe.”
“It’s a nation of commerce and mercenaries. And large wild dragons or monsters don’t fly over areas with people.”
“At this rate, there shouldn’t be any environmental problems, but the issue is Motoyasu-kun’s magic. What if it starts a fire?”
“Don’t worry. I’ve taken precautions on that front.”

Since it’s a display spell, it doesn’t have any effect that burns objects. That’s something I can adjust. Though, the downside is that it requires a slightly complicated process, more magic consumption, and longer chanting time. By the way, it can’t differentiate between friend and foe. It would be convenient if I could create a wide-area attack spell that doesn’t harm allies. For now, it’s just a useful spell for launching fireworks.
“Well, since Motoyasu-kun did it out of happiness for reuniting with that Filo kid, I guess there’s no problem?”

With that said, Father and the others watched the fireworks I launched. And so, we moved on to the meal with the moles. As a party trick, I used fire magic to create small butterflies and birds and made them dance.
“Motoyasu-kun, you’ve got all kinds of tricks up your sleeve.”
“If it’s something like this, I’m sure even Ren or Itsuki could manage it.”
Father specializes in healing and support, so it’s a different skillset for him. But since it requires delicate control, I wouldn’t normally do this unless it’s for a party.
“It’s dangerous, so don’t touch it.”
After all, it’s still a modification of fire magic. I’m just making it dance around me for display. Its power isn’t that strong, but it’s still hot to the touch.
“As expected of Motoyasu-sama!”
“Gaelion could do that too, you know!”
My rival was making a fuss about something, but I paid no mind. Yuki-chan’s praise, however, I accepted wholeheartedly. Meanwhile, the moles were eating their meals as they pleased.
Chapter 720 – Celebration
“Heroes, thank you for preparing this gathering.”
“No, no, don’t hold back. Everyone should just enjoy themselves.”
“Yes.”
They’re a rather reserved bunch.
Or should I say, serious?
“Once we return to the village, we should assess the extent of the damage.”
“If the queen of Melromarc and Lady Seyaette lend their strength, the restoration should proceed faster than expected. The issue is manpower.”
“It’s also important to consider how long we’ll have to keep fighting the Waves. Our numbers have dwindled, but we need to increase them…”
“We should also select those capable of fighting to assist the heroes. How should we go about that selection?”
While eating, they were repeatedly reflecting on Father’s words and discussing what to do once they returned to the village.
Hmm… they’re truly admirable for working so hard for Father. They should keep up that spirit.
“I ordered as usual since Imia-chan said it was fine, but are there any traditional dishes?”
The mole nodded in response to Father’s question. Now that I think about it, they used to eat some unique dishes back in the village.
“Y-Yes, we do, but it’s fine. Everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.”
“That’s good, but… it looks more like a meeting with food than a celebration…”
Indeed. The only ones praising me are Yuki-chan and a few considerate moles.
“I’ll liven things up! Who wants to have a drinking contest?”
“Sadina-san took this opportunity to start drinking… Well, as long as she’s making it lively, I guess it’s fine.”

As Sadina’s sister started drinking with gusto, the mercenaries and adventurers in the tavern cheered her on. That energy was contagious, and gradually, the serious atmosphere among the moles shifted to a more cheerful and lively one.
“Alright, alright! Let’s do some introductions and… play a little game! The loser has to reveal who they’re interested in!”
Father, not to be outdone by Sadina’s sister, was doing his best to keep the mood lively.

What kind of game is this? As I was wondering that, it seemed to be a high-and-low dice game. Whoever failed to guess correctly until the end would have to do a penalty game. It seems he really did manage events before. Back in the day, when I participated in group dates, there were always people trying to liven things up like this. Though many disliked it, these things tend to get people excited. Especially when alcohol is involved, the atmosphere heats up even more. Apparently, the idea of making the loser reveal who they’re interested in came from Father, who inferred it from the moles’ conversations. Since their numbers had dwindled after the attacks on the settlement, they needed to… increase their population through marriage between species or something like that.

Aren’t they all related? That thought crossed my mind, but the moles seemed to understand the situation to some extent. Besides, many of them had met their kin during their time as slaves, so it apparently wasn’t much of an issue.
“Whoa! I lost!”
Even though the mole who lost was embarrassed, they didn’t seem to mind.
“The one I like is—”
And so, confessions happened, leaving the other party blushing.
Could it be… a couple was born?
“Oh my! Naofumi-chan’s side looks like they’re having so much fun! I won’t lose either!”
“Sadina-san, you’re just drinking!”

Naofumi pointed it out, but Sadina’s sister didn’t stop. No matter how much she drank, she just wouldn’t stop. Though not as much as Father, she seemed to be incredibly strong when it came to alcohol.
“Oh my? You’re not eating much. Is there something you don’t like? Should I eat it for you?”

Sadina’s sister, while drinking, approached the younger moles and gently spoke to them to ease their tension. The lively and joyful meal… passed by in an instant. The meal lasted about an hour and a half, and the moles seemed satisfied. When Ren and Éclair came to pick them up, everyone had cheerful expressions, and the younger ones looked as if they were about to cry, sensing that it was time to leave.
“Is it already over? Will we… be made to suffer again?”
Father and Sadina’s sister gently smiled at the young mole, comforting them as if they were their parents.
“I’m really happy if you enjoyed it. But about that question earlier… it’s not the end. This is just the beginning… I guess?”
“That’s right. Just like Naofumi-chan said, things will get even more fun starting tomorrow. You’re all free now, aren’t you?”

Father and Sadina’s sister gently reassured them, and the mole took the young one’s hand, signaling that everything would be okay. The young mole, who was on the verge of being crushed by anxiety, looked relieved.
“Alright, we’ll be moving now. Everyone, please follow Sword Hero Amaki Ren and Lady Éclair, the daughter of the lord, without worry.”
“Understood. We will do our best from now on to respond to the heroes’ kindness shown at this welcome feast.”
The blacksmith mole, acting as their representative, bowed to Father before turning to Ren and Éclair to bow again.
“See you, Naofumi. I’m leaving the recruitment of the panda to you.”

“You’re asking for something unreasonable this late at night… That person seems to like cute things, so maybe I’ll dress up Sakura-chan or Gaelion and take them along? We made good progress last night, so all that’s left is to slip in some ribbons or something.”
“Nano! If Naofumi asks, Gaelion will do his best, nano!”
“Hm?”
“Well, after that—”
At that moment, one of the moles who had been with us raised their hand.
“I… um, I’d like to help.”
“Yeah, Imia-chan might be a good choice too.”

The mole had been dressed up in various outfits by Father with great care. Just like with Sakura-chan and the others, he had been doting on them. That panda was overly sensitive to Keel, but it was all because of the outfits that I and Father had prepared. In that sense, things should go well.
“Alright then, Imia. Do your best to be of help to the heroes. I’m rooting for you.”
“Yes!”
And with that, the blacksmith mole and the mole finished their conversation.
“Alright, we’re heading to Melromarc. Naofumi, or Motoyasu, whichever—send us with the portal.”
Ren’s portal was currently on cooldown.
“Got it. Portal Shield.”
And with that, Ren, Éclair, and the moles were teleported to Melromarc.
“Alright then.”
Father straightened his back and glanced at Sadina’s sister before speaking to the mole.
“I’m not sure if Gaelion-chan and Sakura-chan can stop that person, so Imia-chan, when I give the signal, pretend to yawn like you’re sleepy, okay?”
“Y-Yes!”
Father subtly directed his gaze toward Sadina’s sister while making the request to the mole. Indeed, the mole seemed well-suited for such a task.
“Motoyasu-kun, are you coming too?”
“I have to check on Yuki-chan’s condition, I say.”
Yuki-chan had a race coming up. Considering the breeder’s advice, I needed to make sure Yuki-chan could rest early to perform her best.
“Got it. Well… I don’t know how things will turn out, but we made some progress today. Motoyasu-kun, do your best too.”
“Yes, indeed!”
“Is Gaelion going with the Shield Hero?”
“Nano! Big sis needs to go to bed now.”
Of all things, my rival was waving his hand to put my assistant to sleep. My assistant looked a little conflicted. Father had a similar expression.
“No, no, we can’t just leave Windia-chan out. But… I guess sleep is important too… hmm.”
Father looked troubled.
“In that case, Father, I’ll come to pick them up in place of Sakura-chan and the others.”

In other words, what Father was concerned about was the health of Sakura-chan and the others. He didn’t want them staying up too late. But without Sakura-chan and the others, it would be difficult to establish a connection with the panda.
